title: Maryland Responsible AI Council (MRAC)
tagline: Ethical AI for the State of Maryland
headline: Expert guidance for the responsible use of AI across Maryland
intro: The Maryland Responsible AI Council (MRAC) offers expert advice on artificial intelligence and related technologies to ensure their responsible development and deployment within the State of Maryland.
council_charge: Offers guidance to State agencies on AI advancements and their potential applications in Maryland.

Develops recommendations for the ethical and effective use of AI technologies by and within the State across various sectors to increase awareness regarding AI within the general public and to better prepare Maryland’s workforce to use AI responsibly and equitably.
Proposes improvements to AI-driven decision-making systems used by state agencies.
Assists in developing a comprehensive framework for addressing ethical considerations in emerging technologies.
Makes recommendations on the use and role of AI in education at all levels to enhance learning outcomes.

key_areas.title: AI In Practice
items: Transportation (roads, rails, airports, bridges, tunnels, drones, autonomous vehicles)
Law and society (legal, law, criminal, social systems, civics)

recommendations.title: Responsible Use of AI in Maryland Public Benefits Programs
recommendations.committee: Public Sector Applications and Government Services Committee
recommendations.summary: Nine safeguards for using AI in benefits administration such as SNAP, Unemployment Insurance, and Medicaid, including independent evaluation, explicit privacy protections, a right to human review, equitable performance across groups, and workforce support.

recommendations.title: AI Enabled Identity Fraud and Deepfake Impersonation
recommendations.committee: Public Sector and Law, Civil Rights and Society Committees
recommendations.summary: Five recommendations for implementing Maryland's Chapter 445 deepfake law: better access to civil remedies, enforcement-outcome reporting, validated forensic tools, protection of lawful expression, and review of coverage for identifying images and audio.
